correctness.rationale: The explicit decomposition x0^2 e0 + (1/2) sum_i[((x0+xi)^2-(x0-xi)^2)e_i] uses exactly 2r+1 squares. For any decomposition, the coordinate-quadric space W of dimension r+1 lies in the span L of the squares. Projection x0=0 gives dim L>=dim W+dim pi(L). Since the mixed parts must span x0 V*, r forms v_j with nonzero x0 coefficient are independent; their squares are independent after a basis change, so dim pi(L)>=r and N>=2r+1. This is field-uniform for char!=2. The separate Alder--Strassen multiplication-rank bound is a valid consistency check.
